items.text: New preprint (T. Li and collaborators): the kinematically hot, extremely metal-poor C-19 stellar stream in DESI DR2.
New preprint (A. Levis): dynamic black-hole emission tomography with physics-informed neural fields.
New preprint (P. Dayal): synergising semi-analytical models and hydrodynamical simulations to interpret JWST data from the first billion years.
New preprint (S. Fujimoto): GLIMPSE, an ultra-faint Pop III galaxy candidate and first constraints on the Pop III UV luminosity function at z ≈ 6–7.
